title: Command palette
summary: A ⌘K palette with fuzzy search over grouped commands and recent items, keyboard navigation, inline hints for shortcuts, and a result list that reflows as you type. Realistic app commands, not lorem.

title: Segmented control that morphs
summary: A segmented control whose indicator slides and stretches between segments with a snap you feel, supports drag-to-select across segments, and collapses to a menu below 480px.

title: Date range picker
summary: A two-month calendar where you drag to select a range, hover previews the span, presets like last 7 days sit beside it, and the chosen range reads out in a compact tabular label.

title: Audio scrubber
summary: A waveform scrubber with a hover time tooltip, chapter ticks that magnetise the thumb, a played/unplayed fill, and a tabular timecode that rolls rather than jumps. Mock a real song.

title: Notification stack
summary: Notifications that arrive stacked like iOS, expand on hover to a list, swipe or flick to dismiss with a spring, and collapse back with a counter.

title: Inline-editable table
summary: A data table where cells edit in place, Tab and arrows move focus, edits show a pending state then commit, with an undo toast that counts down.

title: Onboarding stepper
summary: A three-step onboarding flow with a progress rail, steps that slide and cross-fade, per-step validation, and a finishing state that feels earned.

title: Upload drop zone
summary: A drag-and-drop uploader with per-file progress rings, thumbnail previews, retry on failure, and a queue summary line. Simulate uploads with realistic timing.

title: Pricing toggle
summary: Monthly/yearly pricing cards where the numbers roll between values, the savings badge animates in, and the selected plan lifts. Three real-feeling tiers.

title: Colour picker
summary: A picker with a hue ring, a saturation/lightness square, a hex input with tabular digits, recent swatches, and an eyedropper-style preview chip.

title: Slider with detents
summary: A horizontal slider with labelled detents that snap, a value bubble that follows the thumb, keyboard steps, and a fill that eases behind the thumb.

title: Tag input
summary: A chip input with autocomplete suggestions, keyboard removal, paste-to-split, and an overflow state that summarises hidden tags.

title: Toast system
summary: Toasts that stack with depth, pause their progress on hover, support an action button, and can be dismissed with a swipe. A demo panel triggers each kind.

title: Kanban drag
summary: Three columns of cards that drag between columns with a lifted shadow, placeholder gaps that open with a spring, and auto-scroll near edges.

title: Volume and brightness HUD
summary: A macOS-style HUD that appears on key press, shows a segmented level with a tick that overshoots slightly, and fades on a timer.

title: Settings list
summary: Grouped settings rows with toggles, selects and a search that filters rows live, with sticky group headers and a changed-badge that tracks unsaved edits.

title: Media player card
summary: A now-playing card that expands to reveal the queue, with a scrubber, a play button that morphs to pause, and album art that drives the accent colour.

title: Calendar with drag-to-create
summary: A week view where dragging on empty time creates an event, events resize by their edges and snap to 15 minutes, with overlapping events laid out side by side.

title: Bottom sheet
summary: A mobile bottom sheet with three snap points, velocity-aware flicks, a scrim that tracks height, and content that scrolls only at full height.

title: Number stepper
summary: A stepper with press-and-hold acceleration, typed input, min/max rubber-banding, and a value that rolls like an odometer.

title: Context menu
summary: A right-click menu with submenus that open on hover intent, keyboard navigation, icons, shortcuts aligned in a column, and a disabled state that explains itself.

title: Data table
summary: A table with sortable columns, drag-to-resize headers, a sticky header and first column, row selection with shift-click ranges, and a footer with tabular totals.

title: Chat composer
summary: A message composer with @-mention popover, attachment chips, a growing textarea, slash commands, and a send button that reacts to content.

title: Live stat cards
summary: A row of stat cards with sparklines, deltas coloured by direction, numbers that tick live in tabular figures, and a hover that reveals the last 7 points.

title: Login form
summary: A sign-in form with inline validation that appears on blur, a passkey button, a password reveal, and a submit that shows progress then success without layout shift.

title: Radial menu
summary: A menu that fans out from the cursor on long-press, highlights by pointer angle, and commits on release with a satisfying snap.

title: Video scrubber
summary: A timeline scrubber with thumbnail previews on hover, chapter markers, a buffered range, and frame-step keys. Use generated placeholder frames.

title: Progress checklist
summary: A task checklist where completing an item strikes through with a drawn line, the progress bar fills with easing, and finishing everything triggers a restrained celebration.

title: Rating control
summary: A star rating with fractional drag, hover previews, keyboard steps, and a label that reads the value in words.

title: Tabs that morph
summary: Tabs with an underline that travels and stretches, content that slides in the direction of travel, and a collapse into a select at narrow widths.

title: Shortcut cheat sheet
summary: An overlay listing keyboard shortcuts in aligned columns, opened with ?, with a search that filters and a key that lights up when pressed.

title: Reorderable list
summary: A list with drag handles, items that make room with a spring, auto-scroll at edges, and keyboard reordering with announcements.

title: Filter pill bar
summary: A row of filter pills with count badges, multi-select, an overflow more menu when the row is too narrow, and a clear-all that animates the pills away.

title: Password strength meter
summary: A password field with a strength meter that fills in segments, rules that tick off live, and a suggestion to generate a passphrase.

title: Split pane
summary: A resizable split pane with a handle that highlights on hover, snaps near 50%, collapses a side with a double-click, and remembers its size.

title: Anchored comments
summary: Comment threads anchored to selected text in a document, with markers in the margin, threads that open beside the anchor, and resolve states.

title: Now-playing widget
summary: A compact now-playing widget with a rotating artwork disc, a scrubber, and an accent colour extracted from the artwork. Use a real album from src/app/covers.

title: Search dock
summary: A floating search dock that resolves results live from a mocked catalogue, groups them by type, and shows a preview panel for the highlighted result.

title: Avatar stack
summary: A stack of avatars that expands on hover into a row with names, supports an overflow count, and a presence dot that pulses when someone is live.

title: Multi-step form
summary: A form split into steps with a summary sidebar that fills in as you go, edits allowed from the summary, and a review step before submit.
